summary:
Production-Ready Architectural Specification & Implementation Plan (Revision 2) for Category-Dedicated Executive Dashboards across All 16 Verticals in Atrium ERP & CRM:
- Exhaustive Tri-Lingual Localization (French, Arabic RTL, English): Defines exact localization matrices, Arabic typographic rules (Cairo font, mirrored layouts), and bilingual terminology for every chart label, KPI tile, and Guardian alert across all 16 verticals.
- Strict Atrium Design System & Resource Enforcement: Mandates exact design tokens (AtriumButton #C4785A, #F8F9FA elevated pod trays, #1F1D1B Dark Espresso anchors, tabular-nums typography, OfflineRetryBanner, and full-page StructuralSkeletons).
- Production-Grade Data Engine: Details exact store computation algorithms, live state hydration from existing domain stores (sales, members, projects, medical, BTP, etc.), 1-click healing demo data seeders, and zero-data empty states.
- Complete RBAC Authorization Matrix: Explicitly maps Owner and operational manager access rights while locking out front-line operators for all 16 verticals.
- Numerical Formulas & Edge Case Hardening: Worked mathematical examples for all 16 domain KPIs (e.g., OEE/TRS, DAR withholding, RevPAH, 5% Retenue de Garantie, Tiers-Payant, COD Remittance, Churn Rate). Zero code modifications made in this turn.
